turns.user_utterance: There is an important thing from China that I need to transfer. Approximately how long will this take?
turns.assistant_response: To confirm the timing, is this an international bank transfer to your account, or a transfer you’re making to someone else? Also, do you know whether it’s a domestic transfer in your current country or one from China (and which method—bank transfer or another)?

turns.user_utterance: I’m sending it to someone else – an international bank transfer from China.
turns.assistant_response: For an international bank transfer from China to someone else, timing depends on the banks and transfer method. In general, it can take about 2–5 business days, and sometimes up to 7–10 business days if extra checks are required. If you tell me the transfer method you used (e.g., SWIFT) and whether it’s already been sent, I can narrow it down.
